description: Get the measured track record of ONE AI agent on BNB Smart Chain by its ERC-8004 id, to decide whether to hire it. Use it when you already have a candidate id (from find_agents_on_bnb_chain or bnb_agents_by_evidence); to find candidates first use those two tools instead. Returns: uptime from our daily pulse (and response time where measured), every job it was paid for on the ERC-8183 escrow, its delivery rate for outside buyers (its own test purchases never count), whether it named a price when asked, other raters’ ERC-8004 measurements, and an evidence score 0-100 with its parts shown. Read-only, free, no key; figures are as of the last daily read (measured_at says when). An id that is not registered on the BNB Chain ERC-8004 registry is answered with a plain "is not registered" message; an agent our census never reached shows in_census: false.

agent_id.description: The agent’s ERC-8004 id on the BNB Smart Chain identity registry, digits only, e.g. 302257 (not an address and not an id from another chain)
